issues.explanation: Chapter 95 first presents司马懿 as already leading the new twenty-thousand? (twenty万 in the source) army out of the pass to attack蜀军, then retroactively says he reached新城, captured孟达, returned to长安 to meet曹睿, and only afterward went out again. Since chapter 94 already ends after孟达’s capture and司马懿’s arrival at长安, this ordering makes his campaign sequence confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the recap of孟达’s capture, or move it before the opening deployment. Begin chapter 95 directly with曹睿 adding辛毗、孙礼 and司马懿、张郃 advancing from长安.
